source.author: verg
source.text: Pars levis clipeos et spicula lucida tergent arvina pingui subiguntque in cote secures; signaque ferre iuvat sonitusque audire tubarum.
source.text_original: Pars levis clipeos et spicula lucida tergent / arvina pingui subiguntque in cote secures; / signaque ferre iuvat sonitusque audire tubarum.
source.text_english: Some polish their shields and bright spears with grease; with rich fat they whet their axes on the whetstone, and they delight to bear standards and to hear the sound of the trumpets.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: propterea elatus es in superbiam et uestimentum tuum est facta luxuria et quasi ex aruina pingui et quodam adipe eructans uerba mortifera non te respicis esse moriturum nec umquam post expletam libidinem paenitentia remorderis.
reuse.text_original: propterea elatus es in superbiam et uestimentum tuum est facta luxuria et quasi ex aruina pingui et quodam adipe eructans uerba mortifera non te respicis esse moriturum nec umquam post expletam libidinem paenitentia remorderis.
reuse.text_english: Therefore you have been lifted up in pride, and your clothing has become luxury, and, as though from rich fat and some grease, you belch forth deadly words; you do not reflect that you are going to die, nor, after your lust has been satisfied, are you ever gnawed by repentance.
